meaning_hint: Title of the former kings of Iran.
examples: The shah ruled Iran for many years.
The last shah left the country in 1979.
The shah lived in a huge palace.
People protested against the shah.
Almost everyone has a smartphone these days.
I paid for coffee with my smartphone.
Her new smartphone takes great photos.
Kids spend hours on their smartphones.
We watched cowboys ride wild horses at the rodeo.
The town holds a big rodeo every summer.
He was thrown off a bull at the rodeo.
Kids love the rodeo clowns and the music.
He is a titan of the tech industry.
The two titans met for a deal.
She became a titan in fashion.
Titans of business gathered in New York.
note: Used about very powerful people, e.g. "titans of industry".

meaning_hint: Usual spelling блекаут. In Ukrainian mainly a large power outage; English also loss of consciousness, media blackout.
examples: The storm caused a blackout across the city.
We lit candles during the blackout.
The blackout lasted for six hours.
Our fridge stopped working in the blackout.
We sang karaoke until midnight.
Let's go to a karaoke bar on Friday.
She always sings the same song at karaoke.
The party had karaoke and pizza.
We stayed in a cheap hostel in Rome.
The hostel has shared rooms and a kitchen.
Hostels are popular with young travelers.
I met new friends at the hostel.

meaning_hint: For 'premium class/quality' (преміум-клас); an insurance premium or a bonus is премія.
examples: We bought premium tickets with better seats.
This store sells premium coffee.
Premium members don't see any ads.
The hotel offers premium rooms with a view.
Her son was diagnosed with autism.
Autism affects how people communicate.
The school supports kids with autism.
He gave a talk about autism.
The taxi ride cost two hundred pesos.
The peso is the money used in Mexico.
He changed his dollars into pesos at the airport.
The peso fell against the dollar this year.

meaning_hint: Also холестерин (more common in everyday speech).
examples: The doctor told me to lower my cholesterol.
Eggs used to be blamed for high cholesterol.
He checks his cholesterol every year.
Exercise can help reduce bad cholesterol.
He ordered a bourbon on the rocks.
This bourbon comes from Kentucky.
She added bourbon to the cake.
Bourbon is a type of American whiskey.
The team mascot is a big blue bear.
The mascot danced during the game.
Our school mascot is an eagle.
Kids love taking photos with the mascot.
It's a paradox that more choices make us less happy.
The story is full of strange paradoxes.
Scientists still debate this famous paradox.
There's a paradox in being busy but bored.

meaning_hint: Noun only (a mix, e.g. a music mix); 'to mix' is змішувати.
examples: The DJ played a great mix.
This song has a new dance mix.
I made a mix for our road trip.
Her summer mix is on my phone.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian more often says мегаполіс; метрополія = mother country.
examples: New York is a busy metropolis.
The small town grew into a huge metropolis.
Life in a metropolis can be stressful.
The metropolis has millions of people.
The doctor recommended a cancer screening.
Free health screenings are offered at the clinic.
Regular screening can find problems early.
She went for an eye screening last week.
Oxygen is a chemical element.
Gold is a precious element.
There are over one hundred elements in the periodic table.
Water is made of two elements.
We saw an alligator in the swamp.
Don't swim here; there are alligators.
The alligator lay still in the sun.
An alligator has a wider nose than a crocodile.
We have a fish aquarium in the living room.
The kids loved the city aquarium.
Clean the aquarium once a week.
We saw sharks at the aquarium.
The caliph ruled a huge empire.
The caliph lived in a great palace.
He became caliph after his father died.
The caliph was both a political and religious leader.

meaning_hint: Also a deputy's seat in parliament.
examples: The new government has a strong mandate for change.
Voters gave the party a clear mandate.
The council has no mandate to raise taxes.
He won the election and received a fresh mandate.
Let's meet for brunch on Sunday.
We had eggs and pancakes for brunch.
The restaurant serves brunch until two o'clock.
She invited friends over for a late brunch.
Algebra was my favorite subject in school.
She helps her son with his algebra homework.
Basic algebra is useful in daily life.
He failed the algebra test.
I could hear the sarcasm in her voice.
He answered with a lot of sarcasm.
Sarcasm can be hard to read in texts.
Was that a compliment or sarcasm?
note: Uncountable: say "a lot of sarcasm", not "a sarcasm".

examples: The detective carried a revolver.
A revolver usually holds six bullets.
He kept an old revolver in a drawer.
The cowboy pulled out his revolver.

meaning_hint: Noun; the adjective is фашистський. In Ukrainian also often used for the WWII German Nazis.
examples: The fascists took power in the 1920s.
He was called a fascist by his opponents.
The fascists banned free newspapers.
Many people fought against the fascists.
We pay for website hosting every year.
This company offers cheap hosting.
Our hosting provider had problems today.
Video hosting costs more than you think.

meaning_hint: In Ukrainian often the Martini vermouth; in English usually the gin-and-vermouth cocktail.
examples: He ordered a dry martini with an olive.
She sipped her martini at the bar.
Two martinis, please.
This martini is too strong for me.
The beta of the app is open to testers.
You can join the beta for free.
The game is still in beta.
We found many bugs during the beta.
The goblin hid the gold under a bridge.
In the story, a goblin steals a baby.
The kids dressed up as goblins for Halloween.
Goblins in fairy tales are small and ugly.

meaning_hint: Rare, old-fashioned word; the usual Ukrainian words are алфавіт and абетка.
examples: Children learn the alphabet in kindergarten.
The English alphabet has twenty-six letters.
Can you say the alphabet backward?
Ukrainian uses the Cyrillic alphabet.
Voodoo is a religion practiced in Haiti.
The tour visited a voodoo temple.
She learned about voodoo rituals and music.
People in the film believe in voodoo magic.
Opium is made from the poppy plant.
He became addicted to opium.
Opium was once used as a medicine.
The police found opium hidden in the truck.
My son reads manga every night.
This manga was made into a TV show.
She draws her own manga.
The store has a big manga section.
The doctor gave him an antidote to the poison.

They found the antidote just in time.
The body was taken to the city morgue.
Police asked her to visit the morgue.
The morgue is in the basement of the hospital.
He works nights at the county morgue.

meaning_hint: Ukrainian pronounces the final т. Also a wine's bouquet.
examples: He gave her a bouquet of roses.
The bride threw her bouquet.
A bouquet of flowers sat on the table.
She ordered a bouquet for her mom.
The drug blocks certain receptors in the brain.
Taste receptors are on your tongue.
The virus attaches to a receptor on the cell.
Pain receptors send signals to the brain.
Find the volume of the cylinder in this problem.
A can of soda is shaped like a cylinder.
The cylinder has a radius of five centimeters.
Draw a cylinder and label its height.

meaning_hint: The Latin language. More usual Ukrainian: латина or латинська мова.
examples: He studied Latin in school.
Many English words come from Latin.
Latin is not spoken today.
The motto is in Latin.

meaning_hint: Mostly a pressure group; a hotel lobby is also хол or вестибюль. Indeclinable.
examples: The oil lobby is very powerful in the capital.
A strong farm lobby fought against the new law.
The gun lobby spent millions on the campaign.
Environmental lobbies want stricter rules.
note: Also means the entrance hall of a building.

examples: The padre blessed the soldiers before the battle.
The old padre lived next to the church.
Everyone in the village respected the padre.
The padre said a prayer for the sick.

meaning_hint: Rare; the usual Ukrainian word is єнот.
examples: A raccoon got into our trash last night.
The raccoon has a black mask around its eyes.
We saw two raccoons in the park.
Raccoons are clever and good at opening things.
The country held a referendum on independence.

The pilot sat down in the cockpit.

The interviewer asked about my last job.
Look the interviewer in the eye.
The TV interviewer was very polite.
The interviewer thanked us for coming.

meaning_hint: Also the dog breed; boxer shorts are боксери.
examples: The young boxer trains at the gym every morning.
The boxer won the fight in the third round.
She became a professional boxer at twenty-two.
Both boxers touched gloves before the match started.
The earthquake caused a huge tsunami.
A tsunami warning was issued for the coast.
The tsunami destroyed many homes.
People ran to high ground before the tsunami.
